import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    c0,a1,a2,a3,a4,F,G,H,K,w = params[0],params[1],params[2],params[3],params[4],params[5],params[6],params[7],params[8],params[9]
    C=np.cos(w*t); S=np.sin(w*t)
    poly=c0+a1*x+a2*v+a3*x**2+a4*x*v
    return poly+(F+G*x+H*x**2)*C+K*S
